_comment: Scripted test clips. `said` is exactly what the reader is asked to say (the gold transcript); ⏸ marks a ~4 s pause (ignored by the tokenizer, used by the TTS smoke-test generator). Expected per-word labels are derived by aligning `said` against the item text with the same aligner, so a speech path is judged by how close its labels come to the gold labels. Real audio lives in eval/clips/<clip>.<ext>, synthetic in eval/clips_tts/ (both gitignored).

hi-para-a__clean.said: मेरा नाम रीना है। मेरे पास एक गाय है। गाय का रंग सफेद है। वह रोज घास खाती है।

hi-para-a__mistakes.said: मेरा मेरा नाम रीना है। मेरे पास गाय है। गाय का रंग सफाद सफेद है। वह रोज घास खाता है।
hi-para-a__mistakes.notes: repeat मेरा; skip एक; self-correct सफाद→सफेद; matra error खाती→खाता

hi-para-b__halting.said: आज बहुत बारिश हुई। सड़क पर ⏸ पानी भर गया। मोहन ने ⏸ कागज की नाव बनाई। नाव पानी में ⏸ तैरने लगी।
hi-para-b__halting.notes: every word correct, but read word by word with a ~4 second pause before पानी, कागज and तैरने

en-para-a__clean.said: I have a red ball. I play with it every day. My dog likes my ball. He runs after it.

en-para-a__mistakes.said: I have a red bell. I play with it day. My dog licks likes my ball. He runs after it.

en-letter-b__mistakes.notes: letter names; b and d swapped

en-word-a__mistakes.notes: sun→sin, pen→pin (vowel errors; not son, which sounds the same as sun)
